## Setup - Run in console

```{r setup_bifsg, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "stringr", "purrr", "wru", "haven")

missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  options(timeout = 600)
  install.packages(missing_pkgs, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

still_missing <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))]
if (length(still_missing) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required R packages:", paste(still_missing, collapse = ", ")))
}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(wru)
library(haven)

.dir <- getwd()
while (!dir.exists(file.path(.dir, "Data")) && .dir != dirname(.dir)) {
  .dir <- dirname(.dir)
}
parent_dir <- .dir
method_inputs_dir <- file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "interim", "method_inputs")
predictions_dir <- file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "interim", "predictions")
dir.create(predictions_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_file <- file.path(method_inputs_dir, "PPP_BIFSG_interim.dta")
output_file <- file.path(predictions_dir, "PPP_BIFSG_prediction.dta")
pred_cols <- c("pred_whi", "pred_bla", "pred_his", "pred_asi", "pred_oth")
```

```{r load_input, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(paste("Input file not found:", input_file))
}

raw_df <- haven::read_dta(input_file)
required_cols <- c("bifsg_id", "firstname", "surname", "state", "county", "tract")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(raw_df))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

cat("Rows:", nrow(raw_df), " Columns:", ncol(raw_df), "\n")
```

```{r clean_input, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
work_df <- raw_df %>%
  transmute(
    bifsg_id = as.integer(bifsg_id),
    first = toupper(str_squish(as.character(firstname))),
    surname = toupper(str_squish(as.character(surname))),
    state = toupper(str_squish(as.character(state))),
    county = str_remove_all(as.character(county), "[^0-9]"),
    tract = str_remove_all(as.character(tract), "[^0-9]")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    first = na_if(first, ""),
    surname = na_if(surname, ""),
    state = if_else(str_detect(state, "^[A-Z]{2}$"), state, NA_character_),
    county = case_when(
      nchar(county) >= 3 ~ substr(county, 1, 3),
      nchar(county) > 0 ~ str_pad(county, width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    tract = case_when(
      nchar(tract) >= 6 ~ substr(tract, 1, 6),
      nchar(tract) > 0 ~ str_pad(tract, width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

score_df <- work_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(first),
    !is.na(surname),
    !is.na(state),
    !is.na(county) & str_detect(county, "^[0-9]{3}$"),
    !is.na(tract) & str_detect(tract, "^[0-9]{6}$")
  )

cat("Rows removed (missing first):", sum(is.na(work_df$first)), "\n")
cat("Rows removed (missing surname):", sum(is.na(work_df$surname)), "\n")
cat("Rows removed (missing state):", sum(is.na(work_df$state)), "\n")
cat("Rows removed (bad county):", sum(is.na(work_df$county) | !str_detect(work_df$county, "^[0-9]{3}$")), "\n")
cat("Rows removed (bad tract):", sum(is.na(work_df$tract) | !str_detect(work_df$tract, "^[0-9]{6}$")), "\n")
cat("Rows sent to BIFSG:", nrow(score_df), "\n")
```

```{r run_bifsg, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (nrow(score_df) == 0) {
  prediction_step <- tibble::tibble(
    bifsg_id = integer(),
    pred_whi = double(),
    pred_bla = double(),
    pred_his = double(),
    pred_asi = double(),
    pred_oth = double()
  )
} else {
  states <- sort(unique(score_df$state))
  cat("States to score:", paste(states, collapse = ", "), "\n")

  state_results <- purrr::map(states, function(st) {
    message(sprintf("Scoring state %s ...", st))

    tryCatch({
      df_state <- score_df %>%
        filter(state == st) %>%
        transmute(id = bifsg_id, first, surname, state, county, tract)

      census_st <- wru::get_census_data(states = st, census.geo = "tract", year = "2020")

      pred_st <- wru::predict_race(
        voter.file = df_state,
        census.geo = "tract",
        census.data = census_st,
        names.to.use = "surname, first",
        impute.missing = TRUE,
        skip_bad_geos = TRUE
      )

      names(pred_st) <- names(pred_st) %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("\\.", "_")

      for (pc in pred_cols) {
        if (!pc %in% names(pred_st)) pred_st[[pc]] <- NA_real_
      }

      pred_st %>%
        rename(bifsg_id = id) %>%
        select(bifsg_id, all_of(pred_cols))
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("State %s failed: %s", st, e$message))
      NULL
    })
  })

  prediction_step <- bind_rows(state_results)

  if (nrow(prediction_step) == 0) {
    prediction_step <- tibble::tibble(
      bifsg_id = integer(),
      pred_whi = double(),
      pred_bla = double(),
      pred_his = double(),
      pred_asi = double(),
      pred_oth = double()
    )
  } else {
    prediction_step <- prediction_step %>%
      distinct(bifsg_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }
}

haven::write_dta(prediction_step, output_file)
cat("Wrote prediction file:", output_file, "\n")
```
